name: Frontend User Notes – Allow site members to save personal notes from frontend. Fully Ajax.
author: wppatch.com

sections.description:
Allow site members and registered users to add and save personal notes from site’s frontend. The notes add and update in real time using ajax. Suitable for membership sites or e-learning sites. Fast, secure and fully customizable.

** Only works for logged in users/members. **

**After activating the plugin, visit the frontend of the site to see it in action. **

**Please rate if you like this plugin 🙂 **
sections.installation:
Install the plugin and activate. Go to Frontend User Notes options page under Settings menu and customize it.
Visit the frontend of the site to see it in action.
